```json
{"facts": {"diff": "difflib.unified_diff", "flag": "re.IGNORECASE"}}
```

`difflib.unified_diff(a, b, fromfile=..., tofile=...)` compares two sequences of lines and produces a unified diff, so you can use it on two config texts split into lines. The `re.IGNORECASE` flag (short form `re.I`) turns on case-insensitive matching.
